info.desc: Originally released back in 1993, Kit Watkins' seminal classic Circle was re-released, in 2008 by Earth Mantra, and can be downloaded from earthmantra.com/circle. This Creative Commons release of the album is provided both as a single seamless recording with all crossfades preserved, as well as broken up into individual tracks, to allow the listener to hear the album as originally envisioned as well as on a track by track basis. The tracks on this release are: All Things The Harbinger Under Temporal Blankets Man/Machine Song of Spring Snake Dance Awash Heated Sky Around and Around Circle of Rain Tumble Dawn's .
